name: tenet
description: A commitment ledger for decisions and rules. Records what you chose, why, and the condition that would reverse it — then comes back when that condition fires. Every rule carries what catches it when it breaks, or `none` and the reason; a rule with no answer is itself the defect.

ledger.title: Decision ledger
ledger.description: Where the notes live. An ordinary directory of markdown files, created on first run if it does not exist. The plugin never owns it: uninstalling leaves it exactly where it is.
